ideas.title: Investigating Minnesota's Medicaid Improper Payments
ideas.description: This story would investigate the federal review that found Minnesota's Medicaid improper payments to be far below the national average. What factors contribute to this low rate, and are there any potential areas for improvement?
questions: What factors contribute to Minnesota's low rate of Medicaid improper payments?
Are there any potential areas for improvement?
ideas.insight: This story could provide valuable insights into the effectiveness of Minnesota's Medicaid program and identify potential areas for improvement. By analyzing the data and speaking with experts, we may uncover best practices that could be applied to other states.
